expectedOutcome: story_advance --phase=TEST shows '[✓] koala-residue: pass — No brand residue in tracked source' as the 7th line in the preflight checklist; when residue is reintroduced, that line becomes '[✗] koala-residue: brand residue: N hit(s)' with the hit lines verbatim in details, and the advance is BLOCKED. lattice validate --help now lists 7 preflight gates (was 5).

outcomeDiff: No difference: A0/spec requirement met. The gate fires structurally in preflight; the script reuses the canonical B-40eb implementation byte-for-byte except for the 4 narrow self-identifier exemptions explicitly invited by the script's own comment.
limitations: Scope expanded to scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs (added 4 narrow exemptions) via scope_contract_acknowledge — script's line 213 explicitly invited story 4 to refine. Authority/production receipts NOT issued (degraded 3x1 fallback used per solo-operator standing approval); authorityDone/productionDone stay false.
pitfalls: The gate's own source file (review-preflight.ts) and label string introduce literal 'koala-residue' tokens that trigger the gate itself — chicken-and-egg. Solution: extend NEUTRAL_TOKEN_PATTERNS with narrow line-level rules for gate self-identifiers (4 rules: koala-residue, KoalaResidueGate*, runKoalaResidueGate, koalaResidue). Future gates that introduce their own brand-prose identifiers must do the same. SCREAMING_CASE constants like KOALA_RESIDUE_GATE_LABEL are automatically covered by the pre-existing /KOALA_[A-Z0-9_]*/g pattern — DO NOT add a redundant rule (caught by quality reviewer F-003 in round 1; fixed in commit 438fa8ef3).
